baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine heart-binding secures the inner center; the temporal sequence then converts that stability into collective rising and voiced testimony.

activation_trace.role: Heart-fortification supplies the stabilizing act that enables the sequence.
The heart as understanding, spirit, and courage is the center being secured.
Rising with resolve converts inward stability into public action.
The two utterances frame both the declaration and its counterfactual self-judgment.

changed_reading.before: The youths became brave and made a monotheistic statement.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an enabled threshold: secured hearts become collective rising and accountable public speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated lord-title spans the whole vertical domain of heavens and earth; refusing any other object of invocation therefore rejects a rival locus of rule, care, and worship.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies ownership and sovereignty across both clauses.
What is above and overshadowing supplies the upper reach of the claimed domain.
The lower realm opposite heaven completes the total domain.
Otherness marks every proposed rival as outside the sole lordship just named.
The worshipped object is the rival status categorically refused.

changed_reading.before: They deny the existence or worship of another deity.
changed_reading.after: They make an undivided-jurisdiction claim: cosmic lordship, sustaining authority, invocation, and worship cannot be assigned to separate centers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ ... لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The declaration audits its own alternative: calling toward another deity would not be neutral wording but a doctrinal position whose speech has crossed beyond the line of truth.

activation_trace.role: Speech as belief or position makes the two sayings commitments rather than bare sounds.
Calling as vocal inclination makes invocation an act that directs allegiance.
Deviation and injustice mark the counterfactual utterance as displaced from truth.

changed_reading.before: The final phrase merely intensifies the denial.
changed_reading.after: The speakers draw a reflexive boundary around responsible speech: an alternate invocation would itself enact doctrinal deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrasts semantic crookedness with upright rectification, then exposes an unsupported divine claim as a mouth-emitted word and demands a clear, compelling proof. The focus speech becomes evidentiary counter-speech: standing straight entails refusing claims that cannot bear their burden.

activation_trace.role: Resolute rising anchors the contextual straightness and proof mechanism in the focus action.
Deviation from truth is the focus verdict sharpened by the context's discourse tests.
Semantic crookedness supplies the negative pole against which the focus utterance is measured.
Upright rectitude supplies the positive pole and activates a straightening echo in their rising.
A meaningful word becomes an inspectable claim rather than harmless sound.
Compelling proof supplies the burden that the rival-god claim fails.
Fabricated falsehood identifies the failed claim's production mechanism.

structural_cues: 18:1-2 place no crookedness beside upright warning; 18:4-5 attach the divine-son saying to no knowledge, a word leaving mouths, and lying.
18:15 immediately expands the focus refusal into a demand for clear authority and an accusation of fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the straight/crooked axis and the proof-versus-fabrication test; I map that axis onto qamu and shatatan. A live alternative is that the opening frame is only thematic and does not directly characterize their posture.

changed_reading.before: Their statement is courageous but principally confessional.
changed_reading.after: Their statement is also a rectifying public argument that places rival theology under an explicit burden of evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request that their affair be prepared toward right action is followed by increased guidance, then heart-binding at the moment of testimony, and later another act of preparation. Binding is thus readable as the inward, action-enabling phase of prepared guidance.

activation_trace.role: Heart-fortification is the focus act interpreted as inward preparation.
Readiness and repair for an affair supply the requested form of divine aid.
Soundly hitting the face of the affair specifies the request as practical right action.
Increase supplies an explicit divine augmentation before the binding scene.
Gentle direction toward the true path names what is augmented.
Repeated preparation after the testimony confirms an ongoing aid pattern with outward provision.

structural_cues: The packet orders request (18:10), increase in guidance (18:13), heart-binding (18:14), and renewed preparation (18:16).
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chronology and repeated preparation language; I infer that heart-binding is one realization of the request. The live alternative is that it is a separate strengthening act not presented as an answer.

changed_reading.before: Heart-binding is an isolated infusion of courage.
changed_reading.after: Heart-binding is a prepared capacity for right action: requested guidance becomes enough inner readiness to rise and speak.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two divine-plural acts use عَلَى with a body organ but regulate opposite directions: hearing is arrested for protected sleep, while the heart is secured for rising and speech. The pair suggests controlled closure of input followed by stabilization of volition and release of testimony.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and withholding supply the input-closing action over the ears.
Listening and reception identify the channel being suspended.
Heart-fortification supplies the later channel-stabilizing act.
Voiced output is the observable result paired against suspended reception.

structural_cues: 18:11 and 18:14 share divine first-person plural agency and the construction verb + عَلَى + possessed body organ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic parallel and branch functions; I supply the directional input/output model. The live alternative is two independent protective acts linked only by narrative style.

changed_reading.before: The sealing of ears and binding of hearts are separate wonders.
changed_reading.after: They form a possible channel sequence: protected withdrawal from external noise precedes a stabilized center capable of truthful output.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names the secured hearts later denotes repeated bodily turning. The youths have a tied center while their bodies are reversed right and left, so firmness is not immobility but preserved allegiance through imposed reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Heart-fortification supplies the stable center.
The heart as inner understanding and courage is what remains secured.
Turning from one face to another supplies the external reversals contrasted with the tied center.

structural_cues: 18:18 places the repeated q-l-b action between right and left while the youths remain asleep.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition and directional reversal; I infer a center-versus-orientation contrast. The live alternative is that bodily turning is only physical preservation and does not comment on allegiance.

changed_reading.before: A bound heart is imagined as fixed and unmoving.
changed_reading.after: The bound heart is an invariant center: circumstances and bodily orientation may reverse without reversing allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: After public standing, the awakened group chooses minute, hidden movement because discovery could force a return to the prevailing creed. Stable hearts therefore support tactical discretion as well as declaration; courage is calibrated to danger rather than equated with constant visibility.

activation_trace.role: Inner steadiness anchors discretion as non-panicked action rather than retreat of conviction.
Resolute rising supplies the public mode that later alternates with concealment.
Smallness, precision, and hiddenness supply the tactical mode of the city mission.
Return after departure supplies the coercive reversal they seek to avoid.
A followed creed identifies the social system into which exposure could reabsorb them.

structural_cues: 18:19 commands delicate movement and non-detection; 18:20 names stoning or forced return to the community's creed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating public and hidden actions plus the coercive risk; I infer both are outputs of the same stable allegiance. The live alternative is that the later caution is merely a new phase with no bearing on the earlier standing.

changed_reading.before: Binding produces fearless, continuously public confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Binding produces non-recapturable allegiance that can speak openly at one threshold and move discreetly at another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speech is sorted by epistemic reach: conjectural sayings about the unseen are curtailed, future-action claims are conditioned, and forgetting triggers remembrance and a corrected saying. The focus certainty is therefore calibrated rather than indiscriminate: firm about allegiance, self-limiting about hidden fact and future control.

activation_trace.role: Speech as doctrinal position anchors the later epistemic calibration in the focus declaration.
The focus self-verdict already marks speech as answerable to a truth boundary.
Repeated sayings that run as conjecture supply the uncertain speech class and its correction.
What is screened from sight sets the epistemic boundary around speculative counting.
An explicit future utterance supplies the speech act that must be conditioned.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure state answered by renewed remembrance and corrected speech.

structural_cues: 18:22 cycles through speculative sayings before redirecting knowledge to the Lord.
18:23-24 restrict an unconditioned future claim and prescribe remembrance and another saying after forgetfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct rules for unseen, future, and forgotten matters; I infer a common ethic of calibrated saying that illuminates the focus certainty. A live alternative is that these rules address separate audiences and should not be unified.

changed_reading.before: The emphatic focus speech models maximal certainty in religious declaration.
changed_reading.after: It models bounded certainty: uncompromised allegiance coexists with disciplined restraint wherever knowledge or agency is not possessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing echo of heavens, earth, and no protector apart from Him culminates in refusing any participant in His judgment. The focus denial of another deity is sharpened into a denial of divided adjudicating rule.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship anchors judgment as part of the focus claim.
The refusal of any other supplies the focus exclusivity.
The refused worshipped status is the focus form of rival authority.
The repeated exclusion of any other extends the focus formula to protection.
Participation supplies the form of divided authority explicitly denied.
Judgment between people specifies the governing function in which no partner is admitted.

structural_cues: 18:26 repeats the heavens-earth scope and the apart-from-Him formula before denying partnership in judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near lexical closure; I infer that it explicates the governance content of the focus lord-title. The live alternative is that the ending is a general coda rather than a deliberate gloss on 18:14.

changed_reading.after: Exclusive lordship includes protection and adjudication: no alternate deity means no co-ruler in judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet never states that fear is transferred. It remains anchored in the focus's fortified hearts and 18:18's explicit filling of an observer with terror, so it is valid as an affective contrast; downstream prose should say the scene suggests protective redistribution, not assert a causal transfer.

activation_trace.role: Fortification under fright supplies the internally stabilized side of the contrast.
The heart as courage localizes the protected affective center.
Filling to the measure of a vessel makes the outsider's fear totalizing.
Fear and panic supply the affect imposed at the protected boundary.

changed_reading.before: Heart-binding only removes or suppresses the youths' fear.
changed_reading.after: The scene may spatialize protection: steadiness fills the inner group while panic fills the uninvited observer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because later building does not say the youths were deified. It remains anchored in their refusal of alternate invocation and in 18:21's taking, building, and prayer-site vocabulary; downstream prose should frame it only as a risk that living testimony becomes institutionally managed memory, never as evidence of a cult.

activation_trace.role: Vocal inclination toward an object anchors the outlier in the youths' living allegiance.
The categorical refusal of another worshipped object sets the non-deification boundary.
Adopting or acquiring supplies the later collective act performed over their memory.
Joining material into a building supplies the conversion of remembered persons into a managed site.
A place of prostration supplies the institutional frame while not itself proving worship of the youths.

changed_reading.before: Their exclusive testimony ends with the immediate confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Its afterlife may expose a tension between lived allegiance and later communities' architectural control of its memory.

strongest_changes: Heart-binding became a staged answer to requested right preparation rather than an isolated courage event.
The 18:11/18:14 body-organ parallel distinguished closure of reception from stabilization for truthful output.
Later turning and tactical concealment recast firmness as invariant allegiance under changing orientation and visibility.
The later rules for saying and the 18:26 coda sharpened the declaration into epistemically bounded speech under undivided judgment.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activations came from repeated constructions and roots rather than broad themes: عَلَى plus a body organ, q-l-b as both heart and turning, q-w-l across confident and speculative speech, and the closing heavens-earth/apart-from-Him echo.
remaining_uncertainties: Narrative sequence does not prove that heart-binding is a direct answer to the 18:10 request.
The ears/hearts input-output model may over-functionalize a stylistic construction parallel.
The architectural outlier supports only a cautious memorialization risk, not deification.
